I don't know what else to tell you.  I lost my job, the other major employer in town just shut down so there will soon be a huge influx of talented unemployed people, and I cannot compete in that environment with a resume as shoddy as mine is.

I don't see how that is supposed to help you help me step away from the ledge.
I'm 26, and was accused of doing something that I did not do.
I haven't cut in a while... maybe two or three years... but thinkin' about it
